name: Implement imaginary-time evolution classically (via scipy expm of -tau*H) to fin
task_prompt: Implement imaginary-time evolution classically (via scipy expm of -tau*H) to find the ground state of the 4-qubit transverse Ising model (J=1.22, h=0.95), and verify by overlapping the result with a Qiskit-exact eigenvector. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
